## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arithmetic, timed as before: ten two-digit multiplications, the sevenths, then 12 percent of 425 and 7 divided by 16 as a decimal. Compare the time to day 7 and write both numbers down.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Bayes, in the form interviewers use: a test for a condition present in 1 in 1,000 people has 99 percent sensitivity and 95 percent specificity. Positive test, what is the posterior? Do it in your head with natural frequencies out of 100,000, not with the formula.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Now the version they follow up with: how good would specificity have to be for the posterior to exceed one half? Solve it algebraically, out loud.
:::
